title: Pure Salamangreat
summary: Salamangreat cards only, with generic staples. Salamangreat Link and Synchro Monsters unlock their strongest effects when reincarnation summoned using a copy of themselves as material, and Salamangreat of Fire locks you into FIRE monsters for the turn.

summary.title: Starters
points: Salamangreat of Fire searches any Level 4 or lower Salamangreat monster on Normal or Special Summon, locking you into FIRE summons for the rest of the turn.

Salamangreat Gazelle Special Summons itself from the hand when a Salamangreat monster is sent to your GY and sends any Salamangreat card (such as Spinny, Jack Jaguar, Roar, or Rage) from the Deck to the GY.
Salamangreat Circle searches any Salamangreat monster from the Deck as a Quick-Play Spell, or makes a reincarnated Salamangreat Link Monster unaffected by monster effects.
Salamangreat Foxy excavates the top 3 cards of your Deck on Normal Summon to add a Salamangreat card.

summary.title: Opening: Salamangreat of Fire
steps: Normal Summon Salamangreat of Fire to search Salamangreat Gazelle, then Link Summon Salamangreat Balelynx to search Salamangreat Sanctuary and trigger Gazelle in hand.

Special Summon Gazelle and send Salamangreat Spinny from the Deck to the GY; revive Spinny and overlay both into Rank 3 Salamangreat Miragestallio, which detaches to Special Summon Salamangreat Weasel or Jack Jaguar from the Deck.
Climb through Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf and reincarnate Salamangreat Raging Phoenix using Salamangreat Sanctuary to search Salamangreat Roar or Salamangreat Rage.

summary.title: Reincarnation Summoning & Tuners
summary.text: Salamangreat Sanctuary lets you Link Summon a Salamangreat Link Monster using a single copy of itself you control as the entire material. Reincarnated Sunlight Wolf recovers a Salamangreat Spell/Trap from the GY, reincarnated Raging Phoenix searches any Salamangreat card from the Deck, and reincarnated Pyro Phoenix destroys every card the opponent controls. Salamangreat Tiger and Salamangreat Weasel act as self-summoning Tuners for Level 8 Salamangreat Burst Gryphon, which revives a FIRE monster from the GY.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Salamangreat Raging Phoenix searches any Salamangreat card when reincarnation Link Summoned, and revives itself from the GY with boosted ATK whenever a FIRE monster you control is destroyed by battle or card effect.
Salamangreat Pyro Phoenix wipes the opponent's entire field when reincarnation Link Summoned—including on the opponent's turn.
Salamangreat Sunlight Wolf recovers a FIRE monster summoned to its zone and a Salamangreat Spell/Trap every turn.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Salamangreat Roar negates any Spell, Trap, or monster effect activation while you control a Salamangreat Link Monster, and resets itself from the GY when you reincarnate a Link Monster.
Salamangreat Rage sends a Salamangreat to destroy a card, or destroys cards up to the Link Rating of a reincarnated Salamangreat Link without targeting.
Will of the Salamangreat, Salamangreat Charge, and Salamangreat Revive provide recurring FIRE revival.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Salamangreat Bastella, Salamangreat Markhor, and Salamangreat Gearblade are not yet released in the TCG.
